title: The Sun Is a Star
text: The Sun is the star at the center of our Solar System. It gives Earth light and heat. Without the Sun, life on Earth would not be possible.

title: Water Covers Most of Earth
text: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water. Most of this water is found in oceans and seas. Only a small part is freshwater.

title: Bees Help Plants Grow
text:
Bees visit flowers to collect nectar and pollen. When they move between flowers, they help plants reproduce. Many fruits and vegetables depend on pollination.

title: Trees Make Oxygen
text: Trees use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make their food. This process is called photosynthesis. It also releases oxygen into the air. title: When were electric cars invented?
text: Electric cars aren't as modern as we might think. According to Energy.Gov, inventors as early as 1828 were working on small electric cars!

title: How We’d Spec It: 2027 BMW 3-Series
text: The BMW 3-series is the poster child for sports sedans, so it’s always exciting when a new generation debuts. The gas-powered Neue Klasse 3-series that can be configured on BMW’s consumer site is available with a 255-hp turbocharged 2.0 four-cylinder (330) or a 437-hp turbocharged 3.0-liter straight-six (M350). In rear-wheel-drive form, the 330 starts at $51,250, while the all-wheel-drive-only M350 starts at $67,250. Regardless of powertrain, both Bimmers offer a wide selection of paint colors, wheel designs, and stand-alone options. That level of personalization makes the new 2027 BMW 3-series a perfect candidate for our How We’d Spec It series.
